ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E19 How's This for a Special? Spaaaace Part: 1 After receiving a galactic crime alert the Titans take off for an epic space adventure.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E21 Monkey Love When Blossom makes a bad call, she becomes afraid to try again.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Pixelator When Chloe sabotages a famous chef's dish, he gets akumatized into Kung Food and those who taste his soup are under his control.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E6 The Fugitives Worried that Miss Grayling has called the police after stealing from Matron's safe, Jo and Connie are too afraid to own up and go on the run. Fred attempts to help them escape, but it's not long before Darrell catches up.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E47 The O Team Security agents Owen and Ohio secretly provide backup on a case so they can have a pizza party.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E2 Dog Hotel The Bears book a night at a hotel for dogs.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E6 A Poached Ego! Our heroes are on the trail of a Pokemon poacher, and Team Rocket is close behind!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Traditions Robby backs out of Alex's traditional Wakwak hunt, so Alex shares his family history with Bumblebee, while Twitch, eager to gain her own traditions, encounters 'Dad2' - Wheeljack.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E11 Apple Thief Finn and Jake are feeling peckish and only one thing can satisfy their hunger: Tree Trunks' world-famous apple pie!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E37 Two Bumble Bees and a Wasp Robin tries to teach the Titans to respect money.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E8 The Test Gumball is livid when an online test keeps telling him that his character-type is \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E16 Baby Caterpillar Unikitty takes in a radioactive caterpillar and raises it like a baby, unaware of the havoc it will wreak as a full-grown adult.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E37 First Contact, Part 1 Captain Roy's first terrestrial expedition takes a disastrous turn, leaving the crew in chaos. All eyes turn to his son, Jim, to lead. But how can a young dolphin possibly fill his father's giant shoes?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Venthalla Owen has his superball confiscated and locked up in Chef's office. Duncan, seeing an opportunity to get help escaping the daycare, leads an away team into the vents to recover Owen's ball.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E4 Mr Pigeon 72 Mr Ramier gets akumatized into M. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now, he can turn people into evil pigeons! To stop him, Ladybug will have to ruffle his feathers once more.

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E35 Blind Ranking Pokemon Spin-Off Games! Hami and Harry are given 4 Pokemon spin-offs to rank, but they don't know what's coming next! Between Pokemon Champions, New Pokemon Snap, Pokemon Quest, and Pokemon Mystery Dungeon, what will be the very best?

ABCMESydney.au.title: LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E1 The Surge After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 After Learn to spell and write the word After. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Red An excitable Red arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour red with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E1 The Third Button Numberblock Three has lost one of her red juggling ball buttons! Can detective Numberblock One help Three to find it by telling the time?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Slime Storm! When Power Paige accidentally causes a Slime Storm, Super Why gets stuck!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E1 How is it Made? Skyscraper In today's episode Maddie is up high! She finds out how really tall buildings are made out of steel and concrete.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E1 Garden Potion After raking up some flowers, Hannah, Kiki and Kai have a scent-sational idea! They collect rosemary, lavender, camellias and lemons to make a sweet smelling potion.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Bones Dr Chris and Dr Xand have brought their lab into Xand's kitchen! In today's episode, the doctors look at bones, and show you an experiment to make them bendy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Pressure Learn how to use air pressure to make your own, home-made rocket out of a plastic water bottle. Phil maxes this out by over-pressurising stronger bottles and finally by building a giant rocket out of plastic bottles.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Atom Bond
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Atom With The Golden Electron Agent Gold is assigned to investigate Project D, headed by Carbon who has trained millions of atoms to develop this plan. Together with Oxygen and Fluorine, Gold penetrates Carbon's secret school and finds atoms being drilled.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 Chips Dr Karl crunches into the crispy, salty, science packed world of chips, proving there's more to one of the nation's favourite treats than meets the mouth.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 Italian Fire Station and Amphibious Crashpad The trip across Italy continues with what might be the coolest fire station in the world. George meets a former paralympian transforming an old air ambulance and Will meets DIY enthusiasts building a summer house for free.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E5 Pointless In an attempt to impress Lucy with his intellectual prowess, Lee joins Daisy as a contestant on the TV quiz show, Pointless.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 Legitimate Targets A Bosnian war criminal is spotted flying into Britain after an attack on a British army base in Northern Ireland, leading the team to suspect that it could be the beginning of a revenge campaign.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E2 Episode 2 George's search for clever ways to beat the housing market sees him meet a young couple creating a home on a bus and an older couple building their retirement on the site of a derelict toilet block.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Days Like This Mark faces an ethical dilemma when deciding whether to report yet another of Doug Ross' indiscretions when he learns that Doug slept with med student, Harper Tracy. Jeanie begins work in the ER as a physician's assistant.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E12 Love and Loopholes Jessica and Louis enjoy a Valentine's Day evening while the boys are being babysat, but Emery gets a shock when he walks in on his parents' special alone time. Eddie strives to take Alison to the Janet Jackson concert.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E7 Fingers And Fumbs QI is the world's most impossible quiz. Hosted by Stephen Fry this episode features Alan Davies, Jo Brand, Phill Jupitus and Dara O'Briain.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E10 The Best Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode packed with some of the best bits from the series. Among the guests are Jo Brand, Emma Bunton, Daisy May Cooper, Stacey Dooley, Rhod Gilbert and others.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E25 Airplane Special Final Boarding call for Mythbusters Airplane Hour! This Airplane special takes off with a myth that will make you feel like you're flying by the seat of your pants.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E4 Luxury 50s Yacht and Upscale Bothy George meets newlyweds who invested their savings into a 1950s former luxury yacht and a farmer who wants to build a Scottish Highland bothy. George's Italian road trip continues and the wilderness lodge starts taking shape.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E1 Ncuti Gatwa, Lady Glenconner, Fay Ripley In this first heat, 9 artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of 3 celebrities: actors Ncuti Gatwa, and Fay Ripley and Lady Glenconner.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Richard Osman's House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Angellica Bell, Gyles Brandreth, Scarlett Moffatt and Iain Stirling test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E5 Marlon Williams, Geraldine Hickey, Big Wett & Rhys Nicholson Marlon Williams, Geraldine Hickey, Big Wett and Rhys Nicholson join Adam, Myf and Alan as they hit such musical heights they have to go into falsetto by the end of it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E7 Visionaries Join Sandi Toksvig for a QI look at some Visionaries with Cally Beaton, Nish Kumar, Laura Smyth, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E6 Nicola Coughlan, Derrick Evans, Sara Pascoe & Dan Walker Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell are joined by guests Sara Pascoe, Dan Walker, Nicola Coughlan and Mr Motivator. Who is telling the truth and who is making it all up?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E10 Gotcha! Featured magicians include Vitaly Beckman, AnnaRose Einarsen, Goncalo Gil and Ren X.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Nyima Funk Aisha Tyler hosts another fun packed episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Nyima Funk.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E22 Moving Targets When a reality show contestant is murdered, Holmes and Watson zero in on another competitor as a suspect, a former war criminal who may be the most skilled killer they've ever pursued. Also, Shinwell asks Joan for a favour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Hell and High Water Dr. Ross becomes a local hero when TV cameras catch him working to save a frightened boy trapped in a drainage pipe which is rapidly filling with water during a torrential rainstorm. Harper helps a young hit-and-run victim.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E5 Pointless In an attempt to impress Lucy with his intellectual prowess, Lee joins Daisy as a contestant on the TV quiz show, Pointless.

ABCMESydney.au.description: E285 Episode 285 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

kptv.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
kptv.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

kptv.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
kptv.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

kptv.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ
kptv.us.description: Universal Basic Guys centers on two brothers, Mark and Hank Hoagies, who lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program. Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

kptv.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
kptv.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

ktbc.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

ktbc.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
ktbc.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

ktbc.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ

ktbc.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
ktbc.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. wbrc.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wbrc.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ

Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wbrc.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ

Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

wbrc.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
wbrc.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wztv.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
wztv.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wztv.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
wztv.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wztv.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ
wztv.us.description: Universal Basic Guys centers on two brothers, Mark and Hank Hoagies, who lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program. Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

wztv.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
wztv.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

wvue.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wvue.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ

kbfxcd.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wivbdt.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
wivbdt.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

wivbdt.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
wivbdt.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wivbdt.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ

"Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children. (Reality, Nature, Animals, Educational) - 2018-09-29

wivbdt.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris

Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

wlky.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
wlky.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wlky.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ
wlky.us.description: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children. (Reality, Nature, Animals, Educational) - 2018-09-29

wlky.us.title: Dr. Chris: Pet Vet
wlky.us.description: Busy veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown encounters many adventures in the day-to-day of a life dedicated to caring for and treating animals. "Dr. Chris: Pet Vet" features the animal and human interest stories he and his friend and colleague Dr. Lisa Chimes -- whom he calls on for animals that require specialist services -- run into as they deal with a variety of animals who undergo an assortment of different treatments, including some of the most intricate and technologically advanced surgeries available. (Reality, Animals, Pets) - 2013-09-28

wlky.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
wlky.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. As Dr. Chris immerses himself in culturally diverse destinations, he takes care to uncover each region's best-kept secrets. (Reality, Travel, Animals) - 2016-10-01

wpmt.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. wpmt.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
wpmt.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wpri.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
wpri.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

wpri.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
wpri.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

wpri.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ
wpri.us.description: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children. (Reality, Nature, Animals, Educational) - 2018-09-29

wpri.us.title: The Visioneers With Zay Harding ᴺᵉʷ
wpri.us.description: International explorer Zay Harding takes viewers around the world as he showcases the remarkable scientists, engineers and everyday people who are creating environmental solutions. (Adventure, Science, Environment, Educational) - 2025-04-05

wpri.us.title: Dr. Chris: Pet Vet
wpri.us.description: Busy veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown encounters many adventures in the day-to-day of a life dedicated to caring for and treating animals. "Dr. Chris: Pet Vet" features the animal and human interest stories he and his friend and colleague Dr. Lisa Chimes -- whom he calls on for animals that require specialist services -- run into as they deal with a variety of animals who undergo an assortment of different treatments, including some of the most intricate and technologically advanced surgeries available. (Reality, Animals, Pets) - 2013-09-28

wpri.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
wpri.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. As Dr. Chris immerses himself in culturally diverse destinations, he takes care to uncover each region's best-kept secrets. (Reality, Travel, Animals) - 2016-10-01

At first, she thinks it's beneath her, but she wants to make her actor lover (Mickey Hargitay) envious, so she agrees, as long as Rock pretends to be her boyfriend. Soon, Rock is running the ad company, but his ascension is greeted by all kinds of personal troubles. (Comedy) - 1957

fxm.us.title: Batman
fxm.us.description: Kaaapowie! Holy feature film, Batman ... one based on the tongue-in-cheek, campy 1960s television series. Watch Batman and Robin battle sharks, Catwoman, The Joker and The Riddler on the big screen. Can they try to prevent the bad guys from taking over the world? With a wham! and a pow! and a zip! ... our heroes just might win. (Action, Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Unbreakable
fxm.us.description: David Dunn (Bruce Willis) is the sole survivor of a devastating train wreck. Elijah Price (Samuel L. Jackson) is a mysterious stranger who offers a bizarre explanation as to why David escaped without a single scratch -- an explanation which threatens to change David's family and his life forever. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama, Science fiction) - 2000

fxm.us.title: Signs
fxm.us.description: Everything that farmer Graham Hess (Mel Gibson) assumed about the world is changed when he discovers a message - an intricate pattern of circles and lines - carved into his crops. As he investigates the unfolding mystery, what he finds will forever alter the lives of his brother (Joaquin Phoenix) and children (Rory Culkin), (Abigail Breslin). A unique story that explores the mysterious real-life phenomena of crop signs and the effects they have on one man and his family. (Thriller, Science fiction, Drama, Mystery) - 2002

fxm.us.title: The Sixth Sense
fxm.us.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Horror) - 1999

fxm.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
fxm.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

fxm.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
fxm.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. fxm.us.title: Underwater
fxm.us.description: Disaster strikes more than six miles below the ocean surface when water crashes through the walls of a drilling station. Led by their captain, the survivors realize that their only hope is to walk across the sea floor to reach the main part of the facility. But they soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they come under attack from mysterious and deadly creatures that no one has ever seen. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2020

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival. (Science fiction) - 1973

fxm.us.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
fxm.us.description: In this classic Western, wanderers Gil Carter (Henry Fonda) and Art Croft (Henry Morgan) ride into a small Nevada town plagued by cattle thieves. Initially suspected of being the rustlers themselves, Carter and Croft eventually join a posse out to get the criminals, who also may be involved in a recent shooting. When the posse closes in on a group that could be the fugitives, they must decide on a course of action, with numerous lives hanging in the balance. (Western) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Gang's All Here
fxm.us.description: The night before his deployment in World War II, wealthy heir Andy Mason (James Ellison) falls in love with Eadie (Alice Faye), a beautiful cabaret singer. The two hit it off, but Mason fails to reveal the fact that he has already promised to marry Vivian (Sheila Ryan), a family friend. When he returns from the war a hero, his father throws a huge party for him, hiring Eadie and her company to perform. Mason hopes to find an out with Vivian in order to marry his true love. (Musical, Romance) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Caprice

fxm.us.title: Bedazzled
fxm.us.description: Stanley Moon (Dudley Moore) is a bumbling short-order cook, infatuated with Margaret (Eleanor Bron), the statuesque waitress he works with at Wimpy Burger in London. On the verge of suicide, he meets George Spiggott (Peter Cook), the devil, who, in return for his soul, grants him seven wishes to woo the challenging Margaret. Despite the wishes and the advice of the Seven Deadly Sins, including Lilian Lust (Raquel Welch), Stanley can't seem to win his love and shake the meddling Spiggott. (Comedy) - 1967

5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Just Friends
5starmax.us.description: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart. (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Switch
5starmax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
5starmax.us.description: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

5starmax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
5starmax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

365blk.us.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
365blk.us.description: In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter. (Historical drama) - 1996

365blk.us.title: Torque
365blk.us.description: When biker Cary Ford (Martin Henderson) discovers some motorcycles filled with crystal meth, he stows them away. But it turns out that villainous gangster Henry James (Matt Schulze) has plans to recover his drugs. James frames Ford for the murder of Junior (Fredro Starr), the brother of Trey (Ice Cube), who heads the Reapers, a notoriously malicious biker gang. Ford goes on the run in an attempt to clear his name, while the FBI and multiple groups of motorcycle-mounted marauders chase after him. (Action) - 2004

365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon
365blk.us.description: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first. (Action, Thriller) - 1987

365blk.us.title: Passenger 57
365blk.us.description: John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers. (Action) - 1992

365blk.us.title: Krush Groove
365blk.us.description: Russell Walker has started a new hip-hop and rap label called Krush Groove, which features a stellar list of acts that includes Kurtis Blow and Run-D.M.C. However, Walker doesn't have sufficient money to keep up the label, especially after Run-D.M.C. scores a big single. As he struggles to fund the label, more and more rap groups, like the Beastie Boys and LL Cool J, emerge in the New York City hip-hop scene. The film is based on the beginning of Def Jam Records. (Musical, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 1985

365blk.us.title: Purple Rain
365blk.us.description: A victim of his own anger, the Kid (Prince) is a Minneapolis musician on the rise with his band, the Revolution, escaping a tumultuous home life through music. While trying to avoid making the same mistakes as his truculent father (Clarence Williams III), the Kid navigates the club scene and a rocky relationship with a captivating singer, Apollonia (Apollonia Kotero). But another musician, Morris (Morris Day), looks to steal the Kid's spotlight -- and his girl. (Musical, Drama, Romance, Music) - 1984

cbsaustin.us.title: Hope in the Wild
cbsaustin.us.description: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children.

"Dr. Chris: Pet Vet" features the animal and human interest stories he and his friend and colleague Dr. Lisa Chimes -- whom he calls on for animals that require specialist services -- run into as they deal with a variety of animals who undergo an assortment of different treatments, including some of the most intricate and technologically advanced surgeries available.

cbsaustin.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
cbsaustin.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. As Dr. Chris immerses himself in culturally diverse destinations, he takes care to uncover each region's best-kept secrets.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller, Mystery) - 20160311

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Hellraiser III: Hell on Earth
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: After learning in Hellraiser II that he used to be British air force Capt. Elliot Spencer (Doug Bradley) -- before he was sucked into another dimension and turned into the pain-craving creature known as Pinhead -- Spencer's soul ends up in limbo. Meanwhile, Pinhead is sealed in a column, which is bought by J.P. Monroe (Kevin Bernhardt). In a dream, reporter Joey Summerskill (Terry Farrell) learns from Spencer she must reunite his two halves to send the murderous Pinhead back to his world. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller, Drama) - 19920815

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Mimic
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: When a cockroach-spread plague threatens to decimate the child population of New York City, evolutionary biologist Susan Tyler (Mira Sorvino) and her research associates rig up a species of "Judas" bugs and introduce them into the environment, where they will mimic the diseased roaches and infiltrate their grubby habitats. So far so good ... until the bugs keep on evolving and learn to mimic their next prey -- humans. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 19970822

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Machinist
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian). (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller) - 20041022

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Pet Sematary
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbor Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller) - 20190316

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Overlord
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Action, Thriller) - 20180922

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Movie, Feature Film, Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 19870911

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Kiss the Girls
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Movie, Feature Film, Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 19971003

moviesphere.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. With crew and country on the line, Glass must assemble an elite group of Navy SEALs to rescue the kidnapped Russian president and sneak through enemy waters to prevent World War III. (Movie, Feature Film, Action, Thriller) - 20181025

moviesphere.us.title: Out of the Furnace

Rodney Baze, Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord. Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home. (Movie, Feature Film, Crime drama, Thriller) - 20131112

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Chato's Land
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 19720624

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Day of the Outlaw
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 1959

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught. (Movie, Feature Film, Western) - 1980

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull. (Movie, Feature Film, Comedy, Drama, Western) - 19760524

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Missouri Breaks
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: When vigilante land baron David Braxton (John McLiam) hangs one of the best friends of cattle rustler Tom Logan (Jack Nicholson), Logan's gang decides to get even by purchasing a small farm next to Braxton's ranch. From there the rustlers begin stealing horses, using the farm as a front for their operation. Determined to stop the thefts at any cost, Braxton retains the services of eccentric sharpshooter Robert E. Lee Clayton (Marlon Brando), who begins ruthlessly taking down Logan's gang. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Drama) - 19760519

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Heaven's Gate
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Harvard graduate James Averill (Kris Kristofferson) is the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyo., when a battle erupts between the area's poverty-stricken immigrants and its wealthy cattle farmers. The politically connected ranch owners fight the immigrants with the help of Nathan Champion (Christopher Walken), a mercenary competing with Averill for the love of local madam Ella Watson (Isabelle Huppert). As the struggle escalates, Averill and Champion begin to question their decisions. (Movie, Feature Film, Western, Historical drama) - 19801119

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Hunting Party
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. shadesofblack.us.title: Belly
shadesofblack.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

shadesofblack.us.title: Eve's Bayou

The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan). (Drama) - 1997

shadesofblack.us.title: Brooklyn's Finest
shadesofblack.us.description: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny. (Crime drama) - 2009

However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family. (Comedy, Romantic comedy, Action, Drama) - 2011

However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Warm Bodies
outtvproud.us.description: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world. (Romantic comedy, Horror, Thriller) - 2013

outtvproud.us.title: Date and Switch

After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

universalmovies.us.title: Mama
universalmovies.us.description: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller) - 20130118

universalmovies.us.title: Unfriended
universalmovies.us.description: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller) - 20140720

universalmovies.us.title: Black Christmas
universalmovies.us.description: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer. (Movie, Feature Film, Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 20191211

universalmovies.us.title: The Darkness
universalmovies.us.description: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller) - 20160513

universalmovies.us.title: Slither
universalmovies.us.description: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 20060331

universalmovies.us.title: Devil
universalmovies.us.description: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller) - 20100917

universalmovies.us.title: The Visit
universalmovies.us.description: Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home. (Movie, Feature Film, Horror, Thriller, Dark comedy) - 20150911

universalmovies.us.title: The Frighteners
universalmovies.us.description: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs). (Movie, Feature Film, Fantasy, Comedy) - 19960719

universalmovies.us.title: Iceman
universalmovies.us.description: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research. (Movie, Feature Film, Drama, Science fiction) - 19840331

universalmovies.us.title: Sssssss
universalmovies.us.description: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notices curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake? (Movie, Feature Film, Science fiction, Horror) - 1973

universalmovies.us.title: The Andromeda Strain
universalmovies.us.description: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton. (Movie, Feature Film, Science fiction, Thriller, Mystery) - 19710312

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Baby Don't You Do It

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - A Man With Money
that70sshow.us.description: Donna and Jackie send Fez to test Pamela's (Brooke Shields) love for Bob; Red has to wear a heart monitor that drives Kitty crazy. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040317

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Happy Jack
that70sshow.us.description: Donna and Eric decide to be celibate until they marry; Fez and Hyde realize how much Kelso has changed when they visit him at the academy. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040324

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Do You Think It's Alright?
that70sshow.us.description: Donna exacts revenge on Eric for not shopping with her by sending him shopping with Jackie; Hyde forbids Jackie to talk about marriage. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040331

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Substitute
that70sshow.us.description: New guy Mitch (Seth Green) tries to make out with Donna; Bob asks Pamela (Brooke Shields) to move in with him. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040421

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Squeeze Box
that70sshow.us.description: Mitch (guest star Seth Green) tells Donna a secret about Eric that makes him seem less than desirable; Red and Hyde see a side of Pamela (guest star Brooke Shields) they will never forget. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040428

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - 5:15
that70sshow.us.description: Mitch (Seth Green) invites Donna to go with him to his brother's wedding; Fez pretends to be rich to impress a woman; Red gets cable installed. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040505

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Sparks
that70sshow.us.description: Chaos results when Eric sneaks a peek at Donna's wedding dress before the big day; Red needs to find a truly meaningful wedding gift for the couple. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040512

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - My Wife
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's bachelorette party takes a surprising turn when Kelso's brother, Casey (Luke Wilson), turns out to be the emcee at a strip club. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040516

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Going Mobile
that70sshow.us.description: Kelso becomes afraid of fatherhood when he meets Brooke's (Shannon Elizabeth) mother, Carolyn (Morgan Fairchild); Eric has second thoughts about marrying Donna and leaves town to sort things out. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040519

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - The Seeker
that70sshow.us.description: Donna's mother returns to console her daughter; Kitty finds Hyde's birth certificate and makes a discovery about his father; Eric tries to explain his actions to Donna. (Episode, Series, Sitcom) - 20040519

that70sshow.us.title: That '70s Show - Time Is on My Side
