truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - The Celts and the Classical World
truehistory.us.description: Studying the earliest written records of the Celts from Italy, Greece and Spain, dating as far back as the sixth century B.C.; scholarly theories about the Celts' migration throughout Europe; the foundation of humanity's understanding of the Celts. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: A New History of Life - The Interconnected Earth
truehistory.us.description: An overview of the unifying idea of Earth system science; this approach views Earth as an integrated network comprising the lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere and biosphere; sampling the complex interactions between these realms. (Educational, History) - 2013-05-10

truehistory.us.title: A New History of Life - The Vast Depths of Earth Time
truehistory.us.description: Pondering how the great antiquity of Earth is discovered; the observations that lead to the concept of deep time; in the process, they develop the tools that can read the story in rocks; ending with an analogy that puts human time into perspective. (Educational, History) - 2013-05-10

truehistory.us.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin - Benjamin Franklin and the American Dream
truehistory.us.description: In Franklin's unfinished autobiography, he creates a persona for himself as a role model others may follow; there is more to Franklin than he shows on the page; surveying the book offers some foundational insights into his life and his worldview. (American history) - 2018-03-02

truehistory.us.title: The Age of Benjamin Franklin - Meet the Franklins
truehistory.us.description: The Franklins are a typical 18th-century family, extended across space; filled with comedy and tragedy, wealth and poverty; meeting his parents and siblings; learning the story of his wife and firstborn son; accompanying Franklin on his travels. (American history) - 2018-03-02

truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - The Origins of King Arthur
truehistory.us.description: Studying images of the Arthurian legend and their relationship to historical reality; tracing the history of post-Roman Britain; the large-scale invasions of the Anglo-Saxons; evidence that a single individual rose up to lead his people. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

truehistory.us.title: King Arthur: History and Legend - An Arthur-Like Figure in Cornwall
truehistory.us.description: Investigating archeological and historical evidence that supports the existence of an Arthur-like figure in early Britain; studying the site of Cadbury Castle, the center of operations of a leader who thwarted the Saxons; the supposed tomb of Arthur. (Books & literature) - 2015-03-06

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - What is a Pirate?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms. (World history) - 2021-05-21

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - Pirate Facts and Fictions
truehistory.us.description: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more. (World history) - 2021-05-21

truehistory.us.title: The Decisive Battles of World History - What Makes a Battle Decisive?
truehistory.us.description: How warfare changes the course of historical events; the factors that make a military battle decisive, such as its role in transfers of power and its social and political effects; the study of battles as an analytical tool for understanding history. (World history) - 2014-06-13

truehistory.us.title: The Decisive Battles of World History - 1274 B.C. Kadesh - Greatest Chariot Battle
truehistory.us.description: The battle of Kadesh ushers in an era of peace in the ancient Near East; the strategy and tactics of the Egyptian and Hittite armies; the unusual sequence of battlefield events that lead to a remarkable treaty; a forerunner of peaceful diplomacy. (World history) - 2014-06-13

truehistory.us.title: The History and Archaeology of the Bible - The World of Genesis
truehistory.us.description: Considering the nature and scope of biblical archeology; how the Book of Genesis makes its case for the existence of a single God; archeological evidence for a great flood in ancient times; its possible connection to the biblical story of Noah. (Religious) - 2021-01-01

truehistory.us.title: The History and Archaeology of the Bible - The Tower of Babel
truehistory.us.description: The symbolism of the tower and pyramid in ancient architecture; the Egyptian step pyramid at Saqqara; the Mesopotamian ziggurat's role in religious life and ritual; parallels between the building of ziggurats and the story of the Tower of Babel. (Religious) - 2021-01-01

truehistory.us.title: The Roman Empire: From Augustus to the Fall of Rome - Dawn of the Roman Empire
truehistory.us.description: Setting the stage for Rome's transition from a republic to an empire; Octavian wins a civil war against Mark Antony; he soon achieves what Julius Caesar could not, a one-man rule over Rome. (World history) - 2019-01-04

truehistory.us.title: The Roman Empire: From Augustus to the Fall of Rome - Augustus, the First Emperor
truehistory.us.description: Meeting Octavian, who becomes Rome's first emperor; he takes the title of Augustus; gaining control of the military; ruling Rome without inspiring his own assassination; how these are some of history's most astonishing feats. (World history) - 2019-01-04

truehistory.us.title: The Roman Empire: From Augustus to the Fall of Rome - Tiberius and Caligula
truehistory.us.description: Despite his achievements, Augustus fails in the key area of choosing a successor; after an almost comical series of events, he secures a male heir to take the throne; witnessing the debacle of Roman leadership under Tiberius and Caligula. (World history) - 2019-01-04

truehistory.us.title: The Roman Empire: From Augustus to the Fall of Rome - Claudius and Nero
truehistory.us.description: The succession after Caligula continues to be a problem for the Roman Empire; Claudius, though physically challenged, is a good administrator; Nero is depraved and self-aggrandizing, nearly bankrupting the empire; tracing the story of their rule. (World history) - 2019-01-04

truehistory.us.title: England: From the Fall of Rome to the Norman Conquest - Exploring How England Came to Be
truehistory.us.description: Seeing what makes Anglo-Saxon England so captivating; a brief survey of the traditional scholarship across the ages; Professor Paxton outlines how to form a picture of the Anglo-Saxons, including written evidence, literary sources and more. (World history) - 2022-01-28

truehistory.us.title: England: From the Fall of Rome to the Norman Conquest - The Rise and Fall of Roman Britain
truehistory.us.description: England is forged in the crucible of the decline of the Romans; exploring the impact of the Romans on Britain, from Hadrian's Wall to the city of London; the role of Christianity, the state of language and the collapsing economy during this time. (World history) - 2022-01-28

truehistory.us.title: England: From the Fall of Rome to the Norman Conquest - The Germanic Migrations to Britain
truehistory.us.description: The three primary invasions of Germanic people that schoolchildren are aware of; reflecting on the accuracy of this narrative; how varying sources, as well as DNA and archeological evidence, paint a much more complex picture of Germanic migrations. (World history) - 2022-01-28

truehistory.us.title: England: From the Fall of Rome to the Norman Conquest - The Britons Resist: The Legend of King Arthur
truehistory.us.description: Pondering whether there is resistance among the locals to Germanic migrations; looking at King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table; investigating Arthur's status as a real person, who he is based on and his impact on the history of Britain. (World history) - 2022-01-28

truehistory.us.title: History of the Ancient World: A Global Perspective - Cities, Civilizations, and Sources
truehistory.us.description: The different kind of approach one will take in exploring the ancient world; hearing a story that illustrates the risks of letting one's own cultural biases and limited perspective overly influence the interpretation of archeological discoveries. (World history) - 2011-12-16

truehistory.us.title: History of the Ancient World: A Global Perspective - From Out of the Mesopotamian Mud
truehistory.us.description: This civilization reveals a theme that appears again and again; grasping the role of geography and resources in shaping Mesopotamia's method of subsistence, religion, structures, empire and means of leaving its written record. (World history) - 2011-12-16

truehistory.us.title: History of the Ancient World: A Global Perspective - Cultures of the Ancient Near East
truehistory.us.description: The lack of geographical barriers makes it difficult for the most powerful cities to retain their power; how a succession of empires rise and fall, leaving behind legacies ranging from the use of intimidation in warfare to seafaring and astrology. (World history) - 2011-12-16

truehistory.us.title: History of the Ancient World: A Global Perspective - Ancient Egypt - The Gift of the Nile
truehistory.us.description: An introduction to Egypt reveals a civilization shaped by geography: how the Nile's annual flooding, though creating a fertile strip amounting to three percent of Egypt, permits civilization to thrive in an otherwise uninhabitable desert. (World history) - 2011-12-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 9. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Conrad van Alphen leitet das Sinfonia Rotterdam, den Octopus Symphonic Choir und vier Vokalsolisten in einer Aufführung von Ludwig van Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 9 in d-Moll op. 125 bei De Doelen in Rotterdam aus dem Jahr 2019. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-02

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 & Sinfonie Nr. 35
classica.us.description: Stefano Conticello dirigiert das Orchester des Teatro Comunale di Bologna in einem Konzert. Es wird mit der Ouvertüre aus Mozarts beliebter Oper "Die Zauberflöte" eröffnet. Es folgt das Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 in C-Dur, mit Maurizio Baglini als Solist. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-01-01

classica.us.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
classica.us.description: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-08-11

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 2. Sinfonie, op. 17
classica.us.description: Das London Symphony Orchestra spielt unter der Leitung des Amerikaners Michael Tilson Thomas Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll. Die Symphonie trägt auch den Spitznamen "Kleinrussische", da ukrainische Volkslieder mit einflossen. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-11-08

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87
classica.us.description: Der Pianist David Levy spielt die 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87, von Dmitri Schostakowitsch. Der Komponist ließ sich dazu von Bachs "Wohltemperiertem Klavier" inspirieren. Das Konzert fand 2023 im Budapest Music Center statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-04-05

classica.us.title: Bach - 5. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 5 in D-Dur, BWV 1050. Das Cembalo tritt zusammen mit Flöte und Geige in diesem Konzert als Solist auf. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-04-01

classica.us.title: Romeo und Julia
classica.us.description: Sergei Prokofjew gründete sein Ballett "Romeo und Julia" auf William Shakespeares gleichnamigem berühmten Stück und erzählt die Geschichte zweier junger Liebender aus den verfeindeten Familien Montague und Capulet. Der renommierte französische Choreograph Jean-Christophe Maillot schuf 1996 eine einzigartige Choreographie des Balletts, die weltweit aufgeführt wurde. (Special, Ballet, Music) - 2013-01-01

classica.us.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
classica.us.description: Das Veerhavenconcert ist eine jährliche Veranstaltung im Hafen von Rotterdam. Diese Aufnahme stammt vom 27. August 2016. Es spielt die Sinfonia Rotterdam unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen. Solisten sind dieses Mal Maria Warenberg (Mezzosopran) und Melle de Vries (Cello). Auf einer schwimmenden Bühne zeigen Spitzenmusiker dem Publikum auf den Booten im Hafen oder auf dem Kai, was sie können. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert)

itvmeridian.uk.title: ITV Racing Live - Newmarket
itvmeridian.uk.description: Ed Chamberlin and Francesca Cumani present live racing from Newmarket and York. Today's feature meeting is at Newmarket where the Group One Dewhurst Stakes for the juveniles is the highlight of the day for the younger horses, whilst the older horses face the unique test of the two and a quarter mile Cesarewitch. Analysis from Jason Weaver and Kevin Blake, reporting from Oli Bell and Sally Ann Grassick plus commentary from Richard Hoiles. (Horse)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Jurassic Park III (2001)
itvmeridian.uk.description: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle. - 2001

itvmeridian.uk.title: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery
itvmeridian.uk.description: Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host as 'Win Win with Postcode Lottery' continues! Studio players compete for luxury prizes, including a car and a holiday - and three viewers playing along from home will win the exact same prizes. Plus, a lucky home winner from last week joins the action in the studio, taking their place on Millionaire's Row. But the contestants face another nail-biting decision: take their prize and leave the game, or trade it for a coveted seat on Millionaire's Row. (Game show) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: The Voice UK
itvmeridian.uk.description: Music superstars take on the role of coaches to find the UK's next great voice. The singer begins their audition with the coaches turned away. itvmeridian.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - South Donegal
itvmeridian.uk.description: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. (Cookery, Travel) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - Effortless One Pan
itvmeridian.uk.description: It's all about effortless and easy one pan wonders as Clodagh shares four all-time favourites. There's broccoli salmon noodles, a perfect 15-minute weeknight supper, and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta that always goes down a storm - both cooked in her lovely outdoor pergola kitchen. Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Unwind with ITV

itvmeridian.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm

10shakeperth.au.title: Wylde Pak
